Origin…

This is an Irish version of the Scottish tune “The ”Glasgow Highlanders“. I doubt if it was ever called ”The Peacock’s Feather" before it was paired with the other hornpipe of that name by Frankie Gavin and Alec Finn on their 1977 Shanachie recording, but I could be wrong about that.

Peacock’s Feather

I have been fascinated by Irish music for decades. In my attempts to bring it to life on an instrument myself, I have now ended up with the melodeon. On the CD ‘An Mileoidean Scaoilte’ by musician Johnny Connolly, I found the piece ‘Peacock’s Feathers,’ which I wanted to try my hand at. With the help of computer technology, I listened to it and transcribed it into musical notation. (In the notation, I deliberately omitted a few notes that appeared less frequently or only sporadically and deviated from the basic pattern. I sincerely hope that these were not the ones that Johnny Connolly would have considered essential!)
Mr Connolly plays the individual sections in the following order: ABABAC.
